create_LTX2VideoHDRProcessor: create an LTX2VideoHDRProcessor instance with configurable vae_scale_factor, resample mode, and hdr_transform
preprocess_reference_video_hdr: preprocess a reference SDR video for HDR IC-LoRA conditioning with aspect-ratio-preserving resize and reflect-padding
postprocess_hdr_video: postprocess VAE decoded output by applying LogC3 inverse transform to produce linear HDR video
decompress_logc3: decompress LogC3-encoded video tensor from [0, 1] range to linear HDR values in [0, infinity)
resize_and_reflect_pad_video: resize a video tensor preserving aspect ratio and reflect-pad to exact target spatial dimensions
